# Progress

How far a task has gone (progress) or a measured value (meter).

- Status: implemented
- Category: feedback
- Pattern: WAI-ARIA APG “meter”; HTML `<progress> / <meter> with a label`
- Text style: `label` (`.nd-text-label`)

## Anatomy

- **track**:
- **indicator**: OpenNetwork progress.
- **value**: In text.

## Variants

- `determinate`:
- `indeterminate`: Still under reduced motion.

## States

- `default`

## Accessibility

- Role: progressbar / meter
- Name: Its label.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (AA)
- 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)

## Contrast

Each pair meets its ratio in every theme and direction (checked on every build).

| `progress.indicator` | `surface.base` | 3:1 |

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-stack">
  <label for="ex-progress">Upload</label>
  <progress class="nd-progress" id="ex-progress" max="100" value="60">
    60%
  </progress>
</div>
```
